average_network_power_w: total represented energy / represented run duration
average_network_throughput_mbps: represented received bits / represented run duration / 1e6
energy_efficiency_mbit_per_j: represented received data volume in Mbit / represented energy in joules
aggregate_packet_loss_pct: 100 * max(0, offered bits - received bits) / offered bits
weighted_prb_utilization_pct: 100 * sum(used PRBs * represented interval) / sum(available PRBs * represented interval)
traffic_weighted_latency_ms: mean cell latency weighted by represented received bits
sleeping_cell_time_pct: 100 * sleeping represented cell-time / total represented cell-time
standards_note: 3GPP TS 28.552 defines 5G performance measurements; TS 28.554 defines 5G KPIs. Energy efficiency uses data volume divided by energy consumption in bit/J.
